description: This file defines the 'OmiProxy' class which implements the 'IOmiProxy' interface. It includes method declarations related to mounting and unmounting crypted bundles, listener registration, and unregistration. The class is within the 'omi' namespace and serves as a proxy for certain OMI operations.

classes.name: OmiProxy
classes.description: A proxy class implementing the 'IOmiProxy' interface, providing mock or default implementations for its methods.

methods.name: bool mountCryptedBundle(const std::string & id,const std::string & rootfs_file_path,const std::string & config_json_path,std::string & bundlePath)
methods.description: Attempts to mount a crypted bundle given its identifiers and paths.

methods.name: bool umountCryptedBundle(const std::string & id)
methods.description: Unmounts a crypted bundle with the given identifier.

methods.name: long unsigned registerListener(const OmiErrorListener & listener,const void * cbParams)
methods.description: Registers an error listener and returns a tag identifying the registration.

methods.name: void unregisterListener(long unsigned tag)
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered listener using its tag.
